english: Let $S$ be the sphere $x^2+y^2+z^2-2x+4y-6z-11=0$ and let $\Pi$ be the plane $x+y-z=1$. The plane $\Pi$ passes through the point $P(5,1,5)$ and meets $S$ in a circle $C$. Then the length of a tangent drawn from $P$ to the circle $C$, in the plane $\Pi$, is
hindi: माना $S$ गोला $x^2+y^2+z^2-2x+4y-6z-11=0$ है तथा $\Pi$ समतल $x+y-z=1$ है। समतल $\Pi$ बिन्दु $P(5,1,5)$ से होकर जाता है तथा $S$ से एक वृत्त $C$ में मिलता है। तब समतल $\Pi$ में $P$ से वृत्त $C$ पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई है
solution: (Same as $PK^2-25=29-25=4$: $PK^2=PN^2+h^2$ and $\rho^2=25-h^2$, so the value does not depend on the plane through $P$)
solution_full: Distance of $K$ from $\Pi$: $h=\dfrac{|1+(-2)-3-1|}{\sqrt{1+1+1}}=\dfrac{5}{\sqrt3}<5$, so $\Pi$ cuts $S$ in a circle.
The centre $N$ of $C$ is the foot of the perpendicular from $K$ to $\Pi$: $N=K-\dfrac{(1-2-3)-1}{3}(1,1,-1)=K+\dfrac53(1,1,-1)=\left(\dfrac83,-\dfrac13,\dfrac43\right)$.
In the plane $\Pi$, the tangent from $P$ to $C$ has length $t$ with $t^2=PN^2-\rho^2=\dfrac{62}{3}-\dfrac{50}{3}=4$, so $t=2$.

Check by the power of $P$ with respect to $S$: $KN\perp\Pi$ gives $PK^2=PN^2+h^2$, hence $PN^2-\rho^2=PK^2-h^2-(25-h^2)=PK^2-25=16+9+4-25=4$. The tangent length is the same for every plane through $P$ that cuts $S$.
originality_note: New: a hidden invariant (way 4): the tangent length from P to the circle cut from the sphere by any plane through P equals the tangent length from P to the sphere, so the messy section circle is not needed. Closest known: the radius and centre of the circle of section of a sphere by a plane; the power of a point for a circle. Different because: the question is about a tangent to the section circle drawn within the plane, and the clean value comes from PK^2 = PN^2 + h^2.

concept_use.Sphere in three dimensions: Centre K(1,-2,3) and radius 5 of S; the circle of section has radius^2 = 25 - h^2, and PK^2 - 25 is the power of P.
concept_use.Plane: Distance of K from Pi, the foot of the perpendicular N (centre of C) and the check that P lies in Pi.
